title: 2026-04-18 checkpoint review and overlay loop
summary: Staged checkpoint review proved the best validation checkpoint appears at iter 40 rather than iter 80, but the selected actor still failed fixed-split 2022 gates. Fixed-actor position-cap sweeps improved 2022 avg_pos only marginally and never passed the full gate. A follow-up single-layer retrain that raised `stress_avg_pos_penalty` from `10` to `25` also failed, with `test_2022 maxDD` still at `46.28%` and `avg_pos` at `0.398`. A reward-only `balanced_reward_guard` retrain also failed, worsening `test_2022` to `47.36% maxDD / 0.412 avg_pos`, so the next loop should stop tuning selector penalties and reward coefficients and instead change the stress set or episode sampling itself.
